name: Ember Anvil
description: Sculpt a hot finite voxel billet into a complete tool head with draw, upset, and split hammer modes.
natural_language: Shape the hot billet to match the complete tool head, including its thickness. Draw moves a top voxel into a lower neighbor; upset moves it onto an equally high neighbor; split discards it. Reheat in the forge when dark. Reheating preserves shape. Use only screenshots and visible task controls; no code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-opened tabs and their visible controls are permitted.

metadata.notes: Original discrete solid-material sculpture; complete volume is independently replayed. Human and agent calibration pending.
